choices.reason: Neither candidate is explicitly designated primary or main, and the abstract/introduction do not report a distinguishing specification. Under rule 2's no-added-controls fallback, the unadjusted randomized contrast takes precedence over ANCOVA, which adjusts for pre-test creativity and demographic covariates.

choices.quote: To test Hypothesis 1, we conducted an ANCOVA examining the effect of AI assistance on post-test creativity scores, controlling for pre-test creativity, age, work experience, gender, and race.
